questions.text: The TKI model explains conflict-handling styles based on two key dimensions. Which of the following correctly identifies them?
Which of the following best illustrates self-regulation in Emotional Intelligence?
options: The ability to know one's emotions, strengths, weaknesses, and recognize their impact on others while using gut feelings to guide decisions
Being aware of what motivates them.
The ability to control or redirect one's disruptive emotions and impulses and adapt to changing circumstances.
Considering other people's feelings especially when making decisions.
questions.correct_answer: The ability to control or redirect one's disruptive emotions and impulses and adapt to changing circumstances.

questions.text: What happens to bond prices when interest rates rise, and why?
options: Bond prices rise because older bonds become more attractive.
Bond prices fall because newer bonds offer higher interest than existing ones.
Bond prices stay the same because interest rate changes don’t affect them.
Bond prices rise because demand for bonds increases with interest rates.
questions.correct_answer: Bond prices fall because newer bonds offer higher interest than existing ones.

questions.text: [Zones of Growth] Drashti has been working in her current role for five years. She knows her tasks inside out and rarely feels stressed. Her performance reviews are - consistently “meets expectations,” but she hasn’t taken on any stretch assignments. Recently, her manager suggested she try leading a cross-functional project, but she hesitated, preferring to stay with what she knows well. Which zone is Drashti operating in?

According to Maslow’s hierarchy of needs, which of the following statements is true?
options: Once higher -level needs are fulfilled, lower-level needs stop influencing behavior.
Needs operate in a strict sequence, and individuals cannot pursue higher needs without fully satisfying lower ones.
In practice, multiple needs may influence behavior simultaneously, though lower needs generally take priority.
Only individuals in high -level roles, like leaders or entrepreneurs, experience all levels of needs.
questions.correct_answer: In practice, multiple needs may influence behavior simultaneously, though lower needs generally take priority.
